scope: Synthetic right-button pan and wheel-zoom handlers in the in-app browser; 1155 parts, 2605 wires, 120 measured frames after 24 warmup frames. Not physical mouse/device acceptance.
decision: Keep Canvas prototype out of dist: dense zoom improves, but dense pan is not consistently faster and control-area frame tails regress. Preserve existing SVG visuals and interactions.
caveats: Early current-SVG runs overlapped the full test suite. Later repeat and front-area runs did not. Browser scheduling varied between runs; these are exploratory measurements, not a universal FPS guarantee.
prototypeFeatures: computed stroke colors and glow filters
original selection traces, junctions and drafts
remainingGates: raster equivalence at multiple scales and device pixel ratios
